If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is <0.33 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to compensate for bearish bias.  
If sentiment is 0.00 in the last 3 days, apply a 1.0–2.0% downward correction across all horizons to reflect market stagnation.  
For late horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment is >0.67, reduce forecast by 0.3–0.8% to align with diminishing momentum.  
If sentiment is 1.00 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.3–0.8% for early horizon to capture bullish momentum.  
If sentiment is 0.67 in the last 3 days, apply a 0.1–0.5% neutral adjustment across all horizons to avoid overfitting.
